
# Interpretation:

# t(df) = t, p, CI\[ll,uu\]

# Report: Mean Difference \| Mean

# Paired Sample T-Test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ptt <- 
  tibble(
    t1 = rnorm(25,5,2),
    t2 = rnorm(25,7,2)
  )

# Comma Method
t.test(ptt$t1,ptt$t2,paired = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Paired t-test

data:  ptt$t1 and ptt$t2
t = -2.8319, df = 24, p-value = 0.009218
alternative hypothesis: true mean difference is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -3.0051324 -0.4714217
sample estimates:
mean difference 
      -1.738277 
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Formula Method
t.test(Pair(t1,t2)  ~ 1, data = ptt)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Paired t-test

data:  Pair(t1, t2)
t = -2.8319, df = 24, p-value = 0.009218
alternative hypothesis: true mean difference is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -3.0051324 -0.4714217
sample estimates:
mean difference 
      -1.738277 
```


:::
:::


# Independent Samples T-Test

# Data Type:

# Two Separate Data Samples


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Comma Method
with(ptt,t.test(t2,t1))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Welch Two Sample t-test

data:  t2 and t1
t = 3.0655, df = 47.683, p-value = 0.003572
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 0.5979595 2.8785947
sample estimates:
mean of x mean of y 
 7.306172  5.567895 
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# Function Method
# Make the Data Wide
ptt_long <- 
  ptt |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
                        names_to = "time",
                        values_to = "score")

t.test(score~time, data = ptt_long)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Welch Two Sample t-test

data:  score by time
t = -3.0655, df = 47.683, p-value = 0.003572
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group t1 and group t2 is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -2.8785947 -0.5979595
sample estimates:
mean in group t1 mean in group t2 
        5.567895         7.306172 
```


:::
:::


# ANOVA

# Data Type

# IV: 3 Levels


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
exp <- 
  tibble(
    grp = rep(c("SSLD","Placebo","Control"),each = 100),
    IQ = c(rnorm(100,120,5),
           rnorm(100,110,5),
           rnorm(100,110,5)) |> round(0)
  )
    
# Formula
# aov(DV ~ IV, data = data)

aov(IQ ~ grp, data = exp) |> 
  summary()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

grp           2   5349  2674.3   106.5 <2e-16 ***
Residuals   297   7457    25.1                   
---
Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
```

:::


# ANOVA's are Linear Regressions!


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lm(IQ ~ grp, data = exp) |> 
  summary()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


```{.r .cell-code}
# Follow-Up Tests
# Save the model, NOT the summary!
aov(IQ ~ grp, data = exp) |> 
  TukeyHSD()
```
